events.title: Odisha begins AI training workshop series for government officials
events.date_basis: Contemporaneous article explicitly says 16 April 2025; partner-hosted reprint published 21 April describes the previous Wednesday.
events.summary: The E&IT Department and Wadhwani Foundation held the first workshop in a planned series to train officials in AI and public-service applications.
events.limitations: This was structured government workforce training, not proof of deployed services. MoUs mentioned in remarks lack signing dates and are not counted as separate events; both reports may share release text.

events.title: Cabinet approves Odisha Artificial Intelligence Policy 2025
events.date_basis: Final clause of primary Gazette expressly records Cabinet approval on 28 May; same-day reporting corroborates it.
events.summary: Cabinet approved a state AI policy covering infrastructure, skills, energy and governance, with a planned AI Mission and coordinating bodies.
events.limitations: Approval is separate from the 18 June resolution and 28 October Gazette publication. Planned sectoral applications and coordinating bodies are not counted as completed deployment.

events.title: Odisha publishes AI Policy in the official Gazette
events.date_basis: Gazette No.4602 is dated 28 October 2025; underlying resolution is dated 18 June. Record tracks publication, not the earlier decision.
events.summary: The official Gazette published Odisha's AI Policy, whose text sets its operating period from the Gazette notification date.
events.limitations: Formal publication is a distinct milestone for the same policy, not a second AI programme. The policy's five-year commencement clause does not prove all institutions or safeguards are operational.

events.title: Odisha and Sarvam sign agreement for sovereign AI capacity
events.date_basis: Company's fetched 9 February release explicitly identifies signing on 6 February 2026.
events.summary: Odisha signed an MoU with Sarvam for AI computing capacity, including a planned 50 MW facility and applications suited to state industries and skills.
events.limitations: 50 MW is planned capacity. This earlier agreement is linked to later AI-park activity, so capacities and investment announcements must not be added as independent projects without project-level reconciliation.

events.title: Odisha notifies rules for AI procurement and implementation
events.date_basis: Notification No.1547 is dated 12 March 2026; Gazette No.1300 carrying it is dated 30 March. Event is issuance, publication_date is Gazette date.
events.summary: The E&IT Department issued operational rules covering AI project selection, procurement, institutional roles and data governance.
events.limitations: Approved denotes a formal departmental notification, not a Cabinet vote. Document prescribes future taskforce, cell and centre responsibilities; issuing rules does not prove compliance, operational institutions or effective safeguards.

events.title: Odisha signs tripartite AI data-centre MoU with HCLTech and Sarvam
events.date_basis: Government and company releases explicitly date signing to 24 July 2026.
events.summary: Odisha, HCLTech and Sarvam signed an agreement to establish an AI data centre in the proposed Odisha Sovereign AI Park.
events.limitations: One tripartite agreement, separate from the HCLTech Global Technology Center MoU signed the same day. The planned ₹14,257 crore capital outlay includes unspecified state financial assistance; no completed facility or expenditure is verified. Relationship to the February Sarvam agreement is retained under the same initiative; do not add its capacity as completed infrastructure.

events.title: Odisha signs HCLTech agreement for AI-led Global Technology Center
events.date_basis: Government and company releases explicitly date signing to 24 July 2026.
events.summary: Odisha and HCLTech signed an agreement for a Bhubaneswar Global Technology Center to develop and deliver AI-led digital solutions.
events.limitations: Bilateral agreement distinct from the same-day tripartite AI data-centre MoU. The ₹730 crore investment, capacity for 5,000 people and 2028 operating target are plans, not verified expenditure, employment or operations. The complementary centres share the Odisha sovereign AI infrastructure initiative.

events.title: Assam budget proposes AI centre of excellence
events.date_basis: Official speech identifies FY2024-25; independently fetched PRS analysis dates its presentation 12 February 2024.
events.summary: The FY2024-25 budget proposed an Assam Centre for Excellence for AI alongside a state data-exchange platform.
events.limitations: No dedicated amount for the AI centre is specified in the cited passage. Adjacent ₹5 crore allocation is for the Gyan Dhara virtual-reality project and must not be attributed to AI. Proposal is not an opening.

events.title: Assam budget proposes AI anti-deepfake laboratory
events.date_basis: Budget speech paragraph 188 contains proposal; contemporaneous PTI reporting explicitly dates presentation to 10 March 2025.
events.summary: The FY2025-26 budget proposed encouraging Assam Police to establish an AI-based anti-deepfake and cyber-surveillance lab.
events.limitations: Language is prospective and no standalone allocation or commissioned laboratory is established. The state's 'India's first' claim is not independently verified and is omitted from the event title.

events.title: Chief Minister introduces AI anchor for Cabinet updates
events.date_basis: Fetched article and embedded public Chief Minister post both give 14 May 2025.
events.summary: The Chief Minister publicly introduced Ankita, an AI-generated Assamese-language presenter delivering updates from a Cabinet meeting.
events.limitations: Evidence establishes a public demonstration of government communication, not routine adoption, accuracy, audience reach or an independently verified service improvement.

events.title: Assam signs Google Cloud AI-governance MoU
events.date_basis: Government signatory's public post says today, 11 November; newspaper describes Tuesday signing and was updated 12 November.
events.summary: Assam signed an MoU with Google Cloud for AI adoption in government and a planned AI centre of excellence, with Paradigm IT as implementation partner.
events.limitations: Public first-person official statement plus reporting establish signing, not the text of the executed agreement. Centre opening, specific enforceable safeguards and training outcomes remain unverified.

events.title: Finance Department issues AI procurement-platform RFI
events.date_basis: Primary RFI FD/PROCUREMENT/AI/2026/01 explicitly dated 15 March 2026.
events.summary: Assam's Finance Department sought market input on an AI-assisted platform for procurement-document preparation, compliance checks and analytics.
events.limitations: This is a concrete pre-procurement action, not a selected supplier, awarded contract, deployed platform or delegated automated procurement decision. Classified by intended public-sector use; stage remains announced.

events.title: Assam commissions government-owned GPU cluster for AI services
events.date_basis: 31 July report says installation was around two weeks earlier and applications were already running. Month precision is supported; exact commissioning day is unknown.
events.summary: The state reported an eight-node L40S GPU cluster at its data centre already supporting AI applications, including an e-Office document assistant.
events.limitations: Operational status is reported through named officials, not independently benchmarked. Eight nodes must not be converted into an assumed GPU count, and no accuracy or usage performance is established.

notes: Extension covers Odisha and Assam, 2024-01-01 to 2026-11-10, with six milestones each. Evidence-led selection, not a comprehensive census or maturity ranking.

Odisha approval, resolution and Gazette publication are different dates. Only Cabinet approval and Gazette publication receive separate milestones; 18 June resolution is preserved in notes instead of counted again.

Odisha 2026 operational-guideline notification date is 12 March; the carrying Gazette date is 30 March. Rules describe institutions to be established, so they must not be presented as proof all institutions operate.
Assam July 2026 commissioning is month-precision. Publication on 31 July is not treated as a commissioning day.
One Odisha July 2026 event bundles two related MoUs but retains separate source descriptions; the technology delivery centre and data centre must not be confused.

Source provenance matters: Wadhwani's workshop page reprints The Hans India; classify as news, not independent primary evidence. Government signatory's public LinkedIn statement is first-person official evidence, not an authenticated executed MoU.
Confidence concerns occurrence and attribution. High confidence in a budget proposal does not mean high confidence in future delivery.
All included sources fetched using Exa. Searches were expanded after useful primary gazettes and official budget documents were located; no source relies only on snippets.

Assam 2025 budget also contains Gaja Mitra AI camera plans, AI agricultural hubs, a tea-auction system and a wider innovation hub. The selected lab record is a bounded example; no claim of completeness.
No formal standalone Assam AI-IT Policy enactment verified in this pass. This is a coverage limitation, not a conclusion that no policy exists.
Public-facing summaries avoid promises of first-in-India status or unverified outcomes. No financial totals should combine company investment proposals, annual allocations and programme envelopes.

QA split: od-2026-hcl-partnerships was replaced by od-2026-hcl-sarvam-data-mou and od-2026-hcl-technology-mou because primary company releases identify distinct tripartite data-centre and bilateral technology-centre agreements. Same ceremony and initiative are not duplicate criteria when the action scopes differ.
